description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the list of custom rules under a specified application program template, sorted by priority in ascending order. Supports paging, fuzzy search by rule name, and filtering by rule ID, priority, action, and application ID
description_zh: 分页查询指定应用程序模板下的自定义规则列表，按优先级升序返回。支持按规则名称模糊搜索，按规则ID、优先级、动作和应用ID过滤
name: ListApplicationCustomRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application template to query. This parameter is required. The template must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的应用程序模板ID，必填。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的模板
parameters.name: application_template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom rule. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 自定义规则名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: application_custom_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The priority of the rule. Exact match is supported. Valid values: integers from 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 规则优先级，精确匹配。取值范围为1~200的整数
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The action of the rule. Exact match is supported. Valid values:
Allow: allows the traffic.
Alert: monitors the traffic.
Deny: blocks the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作，精确匹配。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
parameters.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application custom rule. Exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序自定义规则ID，精确匹配
parameters.name: application_custom_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned information. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English.
This parameter determines whether the returned application names are in Chinese or English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言。取值：
zh：中文，为默认值。
en：英文。
该参数决定返回的应用程序名称使用中文或英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. This parameter is used to filter custom rules associated with the application. The application must exist in the built-in application signature library
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序ID，用于过滤关联了该应用的自定义规则。必须为内置应用特征库中已存在的应用
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: integers greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值需大于等于1，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: integers greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

ApplicationCustomRules.description_en: The list of application custom rules, sorted by priority in ascending order
ApplicationCustomRules.description_zh: 应用程序自定义规则列表，按优先级升序排列

ApplicationCustomRuleId.description_en: The ID of the application custom rule

ApplicationCustomRuleName.description_en: The name of the custom rule

ApplicationTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the application template to which the rule belongs
ApplicationTemplateId.description_zh: 规则所属的应用程序模板ID

Applications.description_en: The list of applications associated with the rule
Applications.description_zh: 规则关联的应用程序列表

ApplicationId.description_en: The ID of the application in the built-in application signature library
ApplicationId.description_zh: 内置应用特征库中的应用程序ID

ApplicationName.description_en: The name of the application. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
ApplicationName.description_zh: 应用程序名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

Priority.description_en: The priority of the rule. Valid values: integers from 1 to 200. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 规则优先级。取值范围为1~200的整数，数值越小优先级越高

RuleAction.description_en:
The action performed after the rule is matched. Valid values:
Allow: allows the traffic.
Alert: monitors the traffic.
Deny: blocks the traffic
RuleAction.description_zh:
规则命中后执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of application custom rules that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的应用程序自定义规则总数
